condition.narrative: Section I.A.1 of the Loan AgreementThe Borrower shall vest the overall responsibility for the implementation of the Project inMOE, and to this end, shall, through MOE:(a) No later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, or such other date asagreed by the Bank, appoint and thereafter maintain a Project coordinator under terms of reference described in the ProjectOperational Manual.(b) No later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, or such other date as agreed by the Bank,establish, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, the Project Steering Committee with composition acceptable tothe Bank and defined in the Project Operational Manual.

Section I.B.1 of Schedule 2 to the Loan AgreementFor purposes of the provision of Primary School Grants under Part 2.1(e) of theProject, upon achievement of DLR#2.1 as described in Schedule 4 of the Loan Agreement, the Borrower, through MOE, shall, uponselection of an Eligible Primary School pursuant to the criteria and procedures established in the POM, enter into a standardagreement with the Eligible Primary School, under terms and conditions acceptable to the Bank (the Primary School GrantAgreement).

title.narrative: 3. Public preschool classrooms assessed using quality assurance mechanism

comment.narrative:
As part of its efforts to improve the quality of preschool classroom, the Ministry is launching the evaluation of the preparatory cycle (EVACYP), which will be implemented in May 2025. Many consultation and preparation meetings, as well as a technical workshop on preschool evaluation, have taken place between the May 2024 mission and the current one to ensure the smooth execution of the evaluation.
A two-day technical workshop was organized on November 5th and 6th on quality assurance and evaluation of Early Childhood Education (ECE) gathering 50 actors from MoE and regions to support the design, planning and implementation of the preschool assessment.

title.narrative: 10. Primary school classrooms equipped with a reading corner

comment.narrative: The procurement of books (storybooks for preparatory and primary classes), dictionaries, and encyclopedias for the benefit of 3,000 primary schools was launched on December 26, 2024. The offers are currently in the opening phase.

title.narrative: 2. Preschool classrooms that have received learning materials and small supplies

comment.narrative: Most of the Furniture for which calls for tenders have been launched have been delivered for 150 preschool classrooms. A call for tenders was launched in 2023 to complete the acquisition of school furniture, playgrounds for 50 preparatory classes, and gymnastics mats for 2,500 preparatory classes. The tender included a total of 14 lots, of which 3 were unsuccessful (lockable cabinets, basketball backboards with hoops, and gymnastics mats). Additionally, 1 lot (white magnetic boards and cylindrical magnets) had its contract with the selected supplier terminated and will be subject to a new call for tenders. The remaining 10 lots, related to school furniture and playgrounds, have been delivered to the additional 50 preparatory classes.
